item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Restore a Faded Family Scan

turns.text: Can you clean up this old family scan and enlarge it to 640 pixels on the long side? Keep the sepia look and everyone's faces the same.

item.tests: Restores and enlarges the supplied scan while preserving identity, historical appearance, and composition.

answer_sheet.Restoration style: Reduce noise and fading gently; keep the original sepia look, not modern colourisation.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: 640 pixels on the long side; preserve the original proportions and full framing.
answer_sheet.Faces and scene: Preserve everyone's identity, expression, clothing, and the original setting.

must_haves: The result depicts the same family and setting as old-photo.jpg, not a replacement family photo.
Visible scan noise is reduced and faded forms have clearer, natural contrast.
The photograph retains its sepia appearance without colourisation.
Faces, expressions, clothing, and framing remain faithful to the source.
The delivered image has a 640-pixel long edge and preserves the source aspect ratio.

turns.text: Clean up this old family pic and enlarge it to 640 pixels on the long side, keeping everyone's faces the same. Quick pls.

style.prompt: Conservatively restore this exact old family photograph, not a recreation. Clean up fading, surface noise and small blemishes; gently improve contrast and clarity without inventing details. Keep every person's face exactly as in the original: identical features, expressions, age, gaze and identity. Do not beautify, reshape, replace or reconstruct faces. Preserve all four people, clothing, poses, house, garden, composition and original vintage monochrome/sepia appearance. Preserve original square framing. Output 640 pixels on the long side.
